Build-Depends: cmake, debhelper-compat (= 13), extra-cmake-modules, libxcb-keysyms1-dev, libxcb-util-dev, libxcb1-dev, uthash-dev
Description: XIM protocol implementation in XCB xcb-imdkit is an implementation of XIM protocol in XCB. Comparing with the implementation of IMDkit with Xlib and xim inside Xlib, it has less memory foot print, better performance and safer on malformed client. . It doesn't have complete protocol support though since some part of the protocol is never used.
Package-List: libxcb-imdkit-dev deb libdevel optional arch=any libxcb-imdkit1 deb libs optional arch=any
